rationale: The agent’s closing message indicates an order modification was performed but provides no evidence of required steps: no explicit user authentication, no verification that the order belongs to the user, no presentation of product options to satisfy “highest resolution, waterproof camera within previous price,” and no explicit user confirmation before executing an order-changing write. The tools list includes a write action (modify_pending_order_items), yet there’s no confirmation step shown and no final, supported details about the change. This violates the policy’s requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s own orders, confirm before writes, and provide correct final information. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
